cap_rule: nearest-rank p90 of the statistic over 48-month windows starting >= 1960-01 (or the row's first month) and ending <= 2020-12; index ceil(q*n)-1 of the ascending sort; integer by construction
price_convention: seller entry quote p = clamp(V0 + 0.5*sigma0, 0.05, 0.95) from forecast/table.json; the matched pool's implicit 0.5 is not used for the demo

products.name: Fuel Pass-through
products.aggregation: arithmetic mean of the weekly rows dated inside the calendar month, floored to 1e-4 usd
products.note: research product; not settled on chain this weekend

proposed_products.name: Diesel Surcharge
proposed_products.units: US No 2 diesel retail price, dollars per gallon (research proposal row; no product defined)
proposed_products.natural_exposure: carriers and fleets paying diesel above a declared level
proposed_products.status: proposal: no threshold, cap or aggregation rule declared; no score is computed

proposed_products.name: Floating-Loan Rate
proposed_products.natural_exposure: borrowers paying a floating rate above a declared level
proposed_products.status: proposal: no threshold, cap or aggregation rule declared; no score is computed

CPIAUCNS.revision_policy: NSA CPI-U is final when issued (BLS); the snapshot is FRED's current values, not an archived first-release vintage
CPIAUCNS.missing_value_policy: strict: an empty level fails unless declared in series.toml known_missing; months must be contiguous; nothing is filled or skipped silently

known_missing.reason: BLS collected no October 2025 CPI (2025 lapse in appropriations) and will not publish it; see docs/commitment-chain.md, Data rules

fallback.rule: 31 CFR 356 Appendix B, I.B.4(iv): last available twelve-month change

CPIAUCNS.fallback_use: presentation and the AR(1) fit input only (data/presentation.py); never the caps or the chain

GASREGW.units: Regular gasoline price, dollars per gallon
GASREGW.aggregation: a weekly reading belongs to the calendar month of its date (a Monday); the month is the arithmetic mean of the readings present, floored to 1e-4 usd
GASREGW.missing_value_policy: empty weekly readings are skipped and the month's reading count is recorded; months must be contiguous; months with fewer than 3 readings are flagged thin

notes.scope: illustrative historical data; the gap fill is presentation-only and the caps read the raw snapshot
